# Claude Chat Mobile
> Self-hosted mobile web UI for Claude Code: a phone UI that drives your own terminal `claude` CLI via the Agent SDK. Same session, same host settings; touch layout, not a screen mirror. Works with any gateway or API key the CLI is already configured for. Single-driver; single-user (n=1) self-hosted architecture.

## Try It / See It
- [Live Demo](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/demo/): The real product frontend, driven by an in-browser fake backend. No install, no server, no network calls (CSP `connect-src 'none'`).
- [Architecture Diagrams](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/diagrams/): 13 interactive diagrams — dual-channel sync, single-driver lock, auth gates, approval lifecycle, push suppression, test placement.

## Primary Documents & Specs
- [Project Overview](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/overview.md): Core positioning, architecture, tech stack & fragile points
- [System Architecture](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/architecture.md): Web & CLI dual-channel model, single-driver state machine & import boundaries
- [Security Model](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/security-model.md): Mandatory token, host-based auth strategy, device approval & DEVICE_APPROVAL_SCOPE
- [Configuration Reference](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/env-reference.md): Single source of truth schema for ccm.config.json & runtime options
- [Architecture Evolution](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/evolution.md): Key decisions (sandbox isolation, access topology, tail attribution)
- [Project Rules & Testing](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/project-rules.md): Host command whitelist, S0-S7 execution slots & commit trailers
- [API & Events Contract](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/api-events.md): Full contract for 31 outbound agent:event types & 58 inbound socket events
- [Drift Notice](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/drift.md): Documented reality vs code facts

### 起点
- [封面与导读](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/index.md): 一句话认识项目，看清这本手册怎么读。 (Tokens: ~1604)

- [系统架构](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/architecture.md): 从手机 UI 到本机 CLI 的分层与数据路径。 (Tokens: ~2117)
- [职责边界](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/boundaries.md): 做什么、不做什么；与 CLI / 云 / SaaS 的分界。 (Tokens: ~2394)

### 第二部分 · 演进历程
- [架构演进主线](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/evolution.md): 同步引擎、单驾驶员、门禁、文档极简等关键阶段。 (Tokens: ~2193)

### 第三部分 · 方法论
- [终端等价性](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/terminal-parity.md): CLI 有什么 Web 就有什么；权限与配置同源。 (Tokens: ~2342)
- [安全模型](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/security-model.md): 单用户、令牌是启动前提、按 Host 的鉴权分支、设备审批与两个边界。 (Tokens: ~2199)
- [单驾驶员模型](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/single-driver.md): Web 与 CLI 不可同时写同一会话；镜像只读追平。 (Tokens: ~1894)
- [契约与工程门禁](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/contracts-gates.md): 事件契约、import 边界、inventory、check 流水线。 (Tokens: ~2329)
- [术语表](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/glossary.md): instance、envelope、mirror、TOFU 等高频词。 (Tokens: ~1753)

### 第四部分 · 核心实现
- [启动与组装根](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/runtime-assembly.md): server.js 薄入口与 app.js 组装根的启动时序。 (Tokens: ~1775)
- [AgentSession](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/agent-session.md): 长驻 SDK query、权限闸、环形缓冲、中断与运行时切档。 (Tokens: ~1711)
- [事件信封与同步](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/events-sync.md): agent:event 信封、seq/epoch、sync:since、catch-up。 (Tokens: ~1594)
- [会话与历史](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/sessions-history.md): 事实源分工、worktree、/rewind 与分叉、删除保护。 (Tokens: ~2029)
- [鉴权与设备信赖](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/auth-device.md): AUTH_TOKEN、CF Access、限速、设备指纹 TOFU。 (Tokens: ~1644)
- [文件与上传](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/files-upload.md): 工作区白名单、三层路径闸、附件与预览。 (Tokens: ~1387)
- [前端与 PWA](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/frontend-pwa.md): app/public/ 分层、Socket 客户端、可安装 PWA。 (Tokens: ~1405)
- [通知与状态栏](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/notify-status.md): Web Push / ntfy、statusline 与 CLI bridge。 (Tokens: ~1733)

### 第五部分 · 数据与集成
- [数据全景](https://ike-li.github.io/claude-chat-mobile/docs-site/pages/data-store.md): CCM_DATA_DIR、transcript、上传与忽略态文件。 (Tokens: ~1741)
